verdict_reason: The CRUD contract IT never sends a malformed body, leaving the GlobalExceptionHandler 500-instead-of-400 path unguarded, and roughly two thirds of the class duplicates sibling IT classes added in the same PR.

todos.issue: No POST or PUT test sends a truncated, empty or otherwise malformed JSON body, so the file never exercises HttpMessageNotReadableException — which is a RuntimeException and so falls through GlobalExceptionHandler's @ExceptionHandler(RuntimeException.class) catch-all to a 500 internal-error, contradicting the POST/PUT 400 anyOf(ValidationProblem, Problem) contract declared on OperatorController.
todos.fix: Add two tests here — POST with content("{\"name\":") and PUT with content("") — asserting 400, application/problem+json, type .../problems/bad-request and $.errors doesNotExist; then add an @ExceptionHandler(HttpMessageNotReadableException.class) to GlobalExceptionHandler so they pass.

todos.issue: Roughly two thirds of this new class re-tests behaviour that sibling IT classes added in the same PR already cover verbatim: getReturns200WithTheAddressAndItsDeletedFalseSignal / getOfADeletedTombstoneReturns200WithDeletedTrueNotA404 / getOfAnUnknownIdReturns404NotFoundProblem duplicate AddressGetIT; putReplacesTheMutableFields.../putClearsAnOmittedOptionalField.../putOnADeletedTombstoneReturns404 duplicate AddressUpdateIT; deleteOfAnUnknownIdReturns404.../deleteOfAnAddressOwnedByAnotherOrganisationReturns404 duplicate AddressDeleteIT; putWithoutTheOrgHeaderReturns400... duplicates AddressScopingIT; createReturns400ValidationProblemKeyedByCamelCaseFieldNames duplicates OperatorComplianceIT.validationProblemCarriesCamelCaseErrorsMapAndTraceId. Every duplicate is a second Testcontainers-backed round trip and a second place to update when the contract moves.
todos.fix: Cut this class down to what only it covers — the create leg (201 + Location + stamped organisationId, the type/role rejection, the unknown-field drop, countryCode/phone pass-through) and fullCrudRoundTrip... — and delete the get/put/delete/org-header tests that AddressGetIT, AddressUpdateIT, AddressDeleteIT and AddressScopingIT already own.

todos.issue: saveAddress seeds createdAt/modifiedAt with the fixed instant 2026-07-14T09:15:27Z, but MongoConfig has @EnableMongoAuditing and Address carries @CreatedDate/@LastModifiedDate, so both are overwritten with now() on repository.save. putReplacesTheMutableFieldsReturns200AndBumpsModifiedAt therefore asserts isAfter() on two wall-clock instants a few milliseconds apart at Mongo's millisecond precision, not the intended 17-day gap — it can flake if the seed save and the PUT land in the same millisecond, and the fixed instants read as meaningful fixture state when they are dead.
todos.fix: Drop the .createdAt/.modifiedAt builder calls from saveAddress (auditing owns them), and re-read the persisted modifiedAt after the seed save as the baseline, or assert the bump via isAfterOrEqualTo plus an explicit not-equal-to-createdAt check.

todos.issue: createIgnoresEchoedReadOnlyAndUnrelatedUnknownFieldsRatherThanRejectingThem echoes createdAt 2020-01-01T00:00:00Z in the body but never asserts it was ignored — it only checks $.id and $.deleted. id is Mongo-assigned so a leak there is impossible anyway; createdAt is the one echoed read-only field where a client-supplied value silently overwriting the audited timestamp would pass this test unnoticed.
todos.fix: Add .andExpect(jsonPath("$.createdAt").value(org.hamcrest.Matchers.not(startsWith("2020")))) and assert repository.findAll() single element getCreatedAt() isAfter Instant.parse("2020-01-01T00:00:00Z").

todos.issue: The class Javadoc says 'Full-stack CRUD integration test for {@code /operators}', but no such route exists — every request in the file targets /organisation/{orgId}/addresses (OperatorController @RequestMapping). The class name OperatorCrudIT is likewise out of step with the sibling AddressGetIT / AddressUpdateIT / AddressDeleteIT / AddressSearchIT naming for the same resource.
todos.fix: Correct the Javadoc to name /organisation/{orgId}/addresses and rename the class to AddressCrudIT to match its siblings.

todos.issue: getHeader("Location") is dereferenced immediately by location.substring(location.lastIndexOf('/') + 1) with no null guard; if the Location header ever stops being emitted the round-trip test fails with a bare NullPointerException instead of naming the missing header (Sonar java:S2259).
todos.fix: Assert the header first — .andExpect(header().exists("Location")) on the chain, or assertThat(location).isNotNull() before the substring.

todos.issue: Test methods use free-form sentence names (createReturns201WithLocationAndServerStampedOrganisation, putOnADeletedTombstoneReturns404) and carry no Given/When/Then comment blocks, against the integration-testing guide which mandates {subject}_{shouldDoWhat}[_{whenContext}] with the HTTP method as the subject prefix and states the Given/When/Then comment blocks must be present.
todos.fix: Rename to the documented pattern (post_shouldReturn201WithLocationAndStampedOrganisation, put_shouldReturn404_whenTargetIsATombstone) and add the // Given // When // Then blocks.
